186 
Once you have selected a subject you can select a lesson by first selecting a 
subtopic. Once a subtopic is selected a drop down will appear showing the 
individual lessons. 
The colour of an individual lesson may be one of the following: 
- Dark blue: lesson has not been completed yet 
- Green: lesson has been recently completed 
- Amber: lesson is ready to be revised 
- Red: lesson is overdue for revision 
The subtopic colour will match the lowest of the listed values above, to help you 
find any lessons that are ready to be revised. 
Also note the value in the bottom right of the lesson card, this will tell you the 
current state of that lesson, and how long until it is ready for revision.
